messages:
alex: Quick check — planning to cut v2.12.0 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Any blockers for the version bump / changelog? Noting a handful of flaky e2e failures in the last run, asking for quick triage.

maria: Which flakes? I just saw job #4928 fail on `integration/payment_flow` and a couple of timeouts in `ui/header-spec`. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/4928

sam: I can take `payment_flow` now. I suspect the flaky is caused by the rate-limit mock being hit intermittently after the http retry landed. Planning to reproduce locally then push a fix or temporary test guard.

jen: Reminder — cutoff for non-blocking changes is 22:00 PT today. If anybody needs a cherrypick for changelog text, ping me.

alex: Thanks — noted on cutoff. If we can get a green sweep of the critical pipelines by 02:00 PT tomorrow we’re good to proceed with the rollout. Hold any perf or experimental switches for post-cut.

ci-bot: Pipeline update: build/v2.12.0-e2e — 3 failed, 12 passed. Failures: integration/payment_flow (flaky), ui/header-spec (timeout), api/ratelimit-spec (race). Rerun recommended.

danny: I synced release branch with main a few minutes ago. No merge conflicts but saw one package version bump in `go-mods` that could affect integration test timeouts. Leaving it unpinned for now unless we hit more flakes.

sam: Quick repro steps I used locally: `mage ci:e2e --focus payment_flow --headless --repeat 20` reproduced a timeout ~1/18 runs. Workaround: re-seed the rate-limit mock and add a short sleep before final assertion. Will open PR with `quarantine` tag if I can't stabilize fast.

maria: Working on changelog snippet for the db migration note. Draft: "Fix: ensure rate-limit mock consistent ordering during e2e to prevent intermittent failures (tests only)." Pushing to `release-notes/v2.12.0` now.

jen: Who's available for an expedited review on the bump + changelog? I can do a quick pass in 20m. @sam @alex

alex: I’ll review the changelog. @sam please flag if you intend to quarantine the test — we should avoid blocking the ship if it's strictly a test flake. Use `quarantine:test/payment_flow` label and leave a TODO in the PR.

sam: If quarantine is needed I'll add label and link to reproduction logs. Trying a rerun first: `ci-bot rerun build/v2.12.0-e2e --job integration/payment_flow --retries 3`

ci-bot: Rerun started for build/v2.12.0-e2e (triggered by sam).

maria: Changelog PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/87 — includes migration note and credit.

ci-bot: Rerun complete: 0 fails, 15 passes. All critical pipelines green.

alex: Awesome — thanks team. Plan: proceed with version bump and start canary rollout at 10:00 PT tomorrow. If anything regresses during canary, abort and revert to v2.11.9.

jen: I'll schedule the canary window and post the ops checklist in #eng-oncall.

danny: Branch tip: I left a small comment to pin `go-mods` to v1.4.2 in the release branch in case we see the timeout reappear.

sam: Thanks — I'll keep an eye on `integration/payment_flow` and follow up if I need to quarantine.

maria: Changelog merged and release notes draft queued. Good to go from my side. :thumbsup:

alex: Great — closing this sync. If anyone sees the flakes come back after the merge, reopen thread or DM. :rocket:
